This prevents N concurrent processes from each independently doing the expensive tree build (reading all files, parsing sections, running git commands).

2. **Extension concurrency limiter** ([extension.ts:548-568](repo/vscode/extension.ts#L548-L568)) — Added `acquireCliSlot`/`releaseCliSlot` semaphore (limit=2) gating all `execAsync` CLI subprocess calls in the VSCode extension (`runRepoCommandJson`, `getTreeNodeCache`, section list, definition list). This prevents the extension from spawning dozens of `cli --json analyze/search` processes simultaneously.
